action_defaults.remove_small_conflicting_detail: Drop the smallest incompatible descriptor first.
action_defaults.swap_surface_state: Replace the current surface state with dry_clean.
action_defaults.swap_setting_micro: Swap the micro-setting within the same macro family if possible.
action_defaults.swap_outfit_detail: Move from the current outfit family to the nearest compatible family.
action_defaults.swap_pose_family: Pick a pose from a different family to reduce repeated shape.
action_defaults.regenerate_macro_block: Regenerate setting macro, outfit family, and pose family together.
